from collections import deque
def solve(g,bg=9):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    Q=deque((i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==bg)
    while Q:
        i,j=Q.popleft()
        if seen[i][j]: continue
        seen[i][j]=True
        for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and not seen[ni][nj] and g[ni][nj]==bg: Q.append((ni,nj))
    res=[row[:] for row in g]; out=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if not seen[i][j] and g[i][j]==bg]
    print("flood cells:", len(seen)-0, "unseen bg:", len(out))
    return res,out
